verdict.rationale: LiteLLM's proxy docs explicitly document configuring `fallbacks=[...]` model groups so a failing model/provider automatically fails over to a healthy backup after retries, including content-policy-specific fallbacks and built-in retry/fallback logic via the Router across deployments and providers. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification that fallback triggers correctly in production incidents (only vendor docs, plus unrelated community complaints about general flakiness rather than fallback-specific failure).
